body.message:
We completely understand your frustration and appreciate your understanding.

We would like to clarify that, as we did not receive any confirmation from your side regarding the updated check-out date and the new check-in dates in August, we were unable to proceed with shortening the existing booking.

Unfortunately, we are unable to modify past booking dates in the system once they have been processed. This is the reason we requested the updated dates in advance, so we could adjust the booking accordingly and create the new reservation for August.

As we did not receive the revised dates from your side, the booking has remained unchanged in the system.

We truly apologize for any inconvenience caused and appreciate your cooperation and understanding.
